75544.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75544.question_text: Which Surah is the longest in the Qur'an?
75544.explanation: Surah Al-Baqarah is the longest surah, consisting of 286 verses as seen throughout Qur'an 2.

75545.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75545.question_text: Who is known as "Kalimullah" (The one who spoke directly with Allah)?
75545.explanation: Musa spoke directly with Allah, as confirmed in Qur'an 4:164: "And to Moses Allah spoke directly."

75548.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75548.question_text: The event of Mi'raj is referenced in which Surah?
75548.explanation:
The Mi'raj event is described in Qur'an 53:13-18: "And he certainly saw him in another descent, at the Lote Tree of the Utmost
Boundary."

75549.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75549.question_text: Which verse supports equality of all human beings?
75549.explanation: Allah declares in Qur'an 49:13: "The most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you."

75550.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75550.question_text: Which Prophet's people were turned into monkeys as punishment?
75550.explanation: Some of Musa's people who violated the Sabbath were transformed into apes, as recorded in Qur'an 2:65: "Be you apes, despised."

75552.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75552.question_text: Who was the wife of Pharaoh that believed in Allah?
75552.explanation: Asiyah's faith is praised in Qur'an 66:11: "And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh."

75554.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75554.question_text: Who was commanded to sacrifice his son as a test from Allah?
75554.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim was commanded to sacrifice his son Isma'il as a test of faith. (Qur'an 37:102).

75556.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75556.explanation:
The people of 'Ad were destroyed by a violent windstorm as mentioned in Qur'an 69:6: "And the people of Ad were destroyed by a
screaming, violent wind."

75557.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75557.question_text: Which angel brought revelations to Prophet Muhammad (SAW)?
75557.explanation: Angel Jibril (Gabriel) brought down the Qur'an to Prophet Muhammad. (Qur'an 2:97).

75559.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75559.explanation: The sons of Yaqub plotted against Yusuf, as mentioned in Qur'an 12:9: "Kill Joseph or cast him out to [some] land."

75560.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75560.explanation: Musa was given the Torah as stated in Qur'an 5:44: "Indeed, We sent down the Torah, in which was guidance and light."

75561.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75561.question_text: The blowing of the trumpet will be done by
75561.explanation:
The trumpet will be blown by Israfil as described in Qur'an 39:68: "And the trumpet will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens
and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom Allah wills."

75562.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75562.explanation: Ayatul Kursi is found in Qur'an 2:255: "Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence."

75563.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75563.question_text: What is the meaning of the name Al-Qur'an?
75563.explanation: The word Qur'an means recitation, as indicated in Qur'an 75:17-18: "Indeed, upon Us is its collection and its recitation."

75564.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75564.question_text: Which Prophet could understand the language of the birds?
75564.explanation:
Prophet Sulaiman was granted understanding of bird language, as stated in Qur'an 27:16: "O people, we have been taught the
language of birds."

75565.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75565.question_text: Which Prophet was swallowed by a big fish?
75565.explanation: Yunus was swallowed by a big fish after abandoning his mission. (Qur'an 37:142).

75566.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75566.question_text: Which angel brought revelations to Prophet Muhammad (SAW)?
75566.explanation: Angel Jibril (Gabriel) brought down the Qur'an to Prophet Muhammad. (Qur'an 2:97).

75567.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75567.explanation:
Yahya's father was Zakariyyah, as mentioned in Qur'an 19:7: "O Zakariyyah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name
will be Yahya."

75568.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75568.question_text: The covenant of all Prophets is referenced in which Surah?
75568.explanation:
Allah mentions the covenant taken from all Prophets in Qur'an 33:7: "And [mention, O Muhammad], when We took from the
Prophets their covenant "

75569.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75569.question_text: The first revealed verses of the Qur'an were in Surah
75569.explanation: The first verses revealed were from Qur'an 96:1: "Recite in the name of your Lord who created."

75575.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75575.question_text: Which Prophet built the Ark by Allah's command?
75575.explanation:
Allah instructed Prophet Nuh to build the Ark, as mentioned in Qur'an 11:37: "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our
inspiration."

75576.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75576.question_text: The longest Ayah in the Qur'an is found in which Surah?
75576.explanation:
The longest verse concerns debt and contracts, found in Qur'an 2:282: "O you who have believed, when you contract a debt for a
specified term, write it down."

75577.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75577.explanation:
The Ka'bah was raised by Ibrahim and his son Isma'il as stated in Qur'an 2:127: "And [mention] when Abraham was raising the
foundations of the House and [with him] Ishmael."

75578.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75578.question_text: The tribe of Quraysh is mentioned in Surah
75578.explanation: The Quraysh are directly mentioned in Qur'an 106:1: "For the accustomed security of the Quraysh."

75579.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75579.question_text: Which Surah states "There is no compulsion in religion"?
75579.explanation: In Qur'an 2:256, Allah states: "There shall be no compulsion in [acceptance of] the religion."

75580.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75580.question_text: The verse forbidding alcohol is found in Surah
75580.explanation:
Alcohol prohibition is mentioned in Qur'an 5:90: "O you who have believed, indeed intoxicants, gambling, [sacrificing on] stone
alters, and divining arrows are but defilement from the work of Satan."

75581.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75581.question_text: The name of the well near which Hajar found water is
75581.explanation:
The well of Zamzam miraculously sprang up near Hajar and Isma'il in Makkah, indirectly referenced in Qur'an 14:37: "Our Lord, I
have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House."

75582.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75582.question_text: Which Surah is called the Heart of the Qur'an?
75582.explanation:
Surah Yasin is called the Heart of the Qur'an due to its comprehensive message, as emphasized in Hadith and referenced in Qur'an
36:1: "Ya, Seen."

75583.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75583.explanation: Prophet Dawud was given the Zabur, as mentioned in Qur'an 17:55: " ... And We gave to David the Zabur."

75584.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75584.question_text: Who was thrown into the fire but saved by Allah?
75584.explanation:
Prophet Ibrahim was cast into the fire by his people but was saved by Allah, as mentioned in Qur'an 21:69: "We said: O fire, be
coolness and safety upon Abraham."

75585.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75585.question_text: Who is said to blow the second trumpet to announce Resurrection?
75585.explanation:
Israfil will blow the second trumpet, reviving the dead, as referenced in Qur'an 39:68: "Then it will be blown again, and at once
they will be standing, looking on."

75586.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75586.explanation: Zakah purifies wealth and soul, as stated in Qur'an 9:103: "Take from their wealth a charity by which you purify them."

75587.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75587.question_text: The people of Thamud were punished with
75587.explanation:
The people of Thamud were struck by a thunderbolt, as stated in Qur'an 41:17: "So the thunderbolt seized them while they were
looking on."

75588.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75588.question_text: Which Surah starts with "By the Fig and the Olive"?
75588.explanation: This oath opens Qur'an 95:1: "By the fig and the olive."

75589.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75589.question_text: Allah perfected the religion in which Surah?
75589.explanation:
Allah declares the perfection of Islam in Qur'an 5:3: "This day I have perfected for you your religion and completed My favor upon
you and have approved for you Islam as religion."

75590.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75590.question_text: What was the occupation of Musa before prophethood?
75590.explanation:
Musa worked as a shepherd before prophethood, as seen in Qur'an 28:23-25: "He found a group of men watering their flocks, and
aside from them he found two women holding back."

75591.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75591.question_text: The splitting of the moon is mentioned in Surah
75591.explanation: The miracle of the splitting of the moon is mentioned in Qur'an 54:1: "The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split [in two]."

75592.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75592.explanation:
Prophet Isa spoke from the cradle to defend his mother, as recorded in Qur'an 19:29-30: "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has
given me the Scripture."

75593.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75593.question_text: What is the name of the surah that bears the name of Prophet Muhammad's family?
75593.explanation:
Surah Al-Imran refers to the family of 'Imran, which includes Maryam (mother of Isa), as seen in Qur'an 3:33: "Indeed, Allah chose
Adam, Noah, the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran."

75594.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75594.question_text: Who was the first human created by Allah?
75594.explanation: Allah created Adam as the first human being and appointed him as His vicegerent on earth. (Qur'an 2:30)

75595.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75595.question_text: Which Surah is often recited for protection from evil?
75595.explanation: Surah Al-Naas seeks protection from the whisperings of Satan (Qur'an 114:1-6).

75596.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75596.question_text: Which Prophet was tested with severe illness and remained patient?
75596.explanation: Prophet Ayyub was afflicted with illness but remained patient (Qur'an 38:41-44).

75597.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75597.question_text: Which Prophet is associated with the building of Bayt al-Maqdis (Al-Aqsa)?

75598.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75598.explanation: Hadith refers to the Prophet's traditions, second only to the Qur'an in authority.

options.text: Sayings and actions of Prophet Muhammad

75599.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75599.question_text: Which companion of the Prophet was nicknamed 'As-Siddiq'?
75599.explanation: Abu Bakr was called 'As-Siddiq' (the truthful) for affirming the Prophet's night journey (Isra').

75600.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75600.question_text: Which Prophet was born without a father?
75600.explanation: Isa was born to Maryam by Allah's command without a father (Qur'an 3:47).

75601.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75601.question_text: Which Surah narrates the story of the People of the Cave?
75601.explanation: The story of the sleepers is narrated in Qur'an 18.

75602.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75602.question_text: In which Hijri year did the Prophet perform his Farewell Pilgrimage?
75602.explanation: The Prophet performed Hajj in the 10th year after Hijrah.

75603.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75603.question_text: Who killed Hamzah (RA) and later became a Muslim?
75603.explanation: Wahshi killed Hamzah at Uhud but later embraced Islam and repented.

75604.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75604.question_text: Who was the mother of Prophet Isa (Jesus)?
75604.explanation: Maryam is the mother of Isa and is highly honoured in Qur'an 19:16-34.

75605.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75605.question_text: Who was the Prophet given the Gospel (Injil)?
75605.explanation: Allah gave Isa the Injil as mentioned in Qur'an 5:46.

75606.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75606.question_text: What is the Arabic term for the pilgrimage to Makkah?
75606.explanation: Hajj is the pilgrimage to the Ka'bah in Makkah, a pillar of Islam mentioned in Qur'an 3:97.

75608.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75608.question_text: Which Prophet was tested with the loss of all his children and wealth?
75608.explanation: Prophet Ayyub showed exemplary patience during great personal loss (Qur'an 38:41).

75610.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75610.question_text: What does the term "Huda" in the Qur'an mean?
75610.explanation: "Huda" means guidance. The Qur'an is described as "a guidance for the righteous" (Qur'an 2:2).

75613.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75613.question_text: The Arabic term for permissible actions in Islam is:
75613.explanation: Halal means lawful or permissible in Islamic jurisprudence.

75616.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75616.question_text: The Prophet migrated from Makkah to which city?
75616.explanation: The migration (Hijrah) was to Madinah, marking a new phase in Islam.

75619.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75619.question_text: What is the Arabic term for voluntary fasting?
75619.explanation: Nafl fasts are extra fasts performed beyond the obligatory ones.

75621.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75621.question_text: How many verses are in Surah Al-Fatihah?
75621.explanation: Surah Al-Fatihah has seven verses and is recited in every unit of prayer.

75627.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75627.explanation: The Islamic (Hijri) calendar starts from the Prophet's migration to Madinah in 622 CE.

75630.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75630.question_text: Which Prophet is known for interpreting dreams?
75630.explanation: Prophet Yusuf interpreted dreams in prison and for the king (Qur'an 12:43-49).

75632.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75632.question_text: What is the Arabic term for the annual charity given by Muslims?
75632.explanation: Zakah is an obligatory act of worship mentioned in Qur'an 9:60.

75636.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75636.question_text: How many compulsory prayers must a Muslim observe daily?
75636.explanation: The five daily prayers are obligatory: Fajr, Zuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.

75681.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75681.question_text: Which Caliph compiled the Qur'an into a single book form?
75681.explanation: Caliph Uthman standardised and compiled the Qur'an (history of Uthmanic codex).

75682.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75682.question_text: The Qur'an was revealed over a period of how many years?
75682.explanation: The Qur'an was revealed over 23 years-13 in Makkah and 10 in Madinah.

75683.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75683.explanation: Surah Al-Naas ends with "Min al-jinnati wan-naas" - "of jinn and mankind."

75684.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75684.question_text: Which surah is named after a woman?
75684.explanation: "Al-Nisa" means "The Women" and addresses issues of women's rights and family law.

75686.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75686.question_text: What is the meaning of 'La ilaha illa Allah'?
75686.explanation: This is the declaration of tawhid, the foundation of Islamic belief.

options.text: There is no deity except Allah

75687.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75687.question_text: Which Prophet was gifted with the ability to control the jinn?
75687.explanation: Sulaiman was given control over the jinn (Qur'an 27:17).

75688.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75688.question_text: What is the Ka'bah also called in the Qur'an?
75688.explanation: Qur'an 5:97 refers to the Ka'bah as "Al-Bayt al-Haram" - the Sacred House.

75689.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75689.question_text: What is the name of the night the Qur'an was revealed?
75689.explanation: Qur'an 97:1-5 refers to Laylat al-Qadr as the night of decree when the Qur'an was sent down.

75690.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75690.question_text: What is the main theme of Surah Al-Ikhlas?
75690.explanation: Surah Al-Ikhlas emphasises tawhid (monotheism) in Qur'an 112:1-4: 'Say: He is Allah, the One ... '

75691.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75691.question_text: What is the ruling on backbiting in Islam?
75691.explanation: Difficulty Level: IntermediateBackbiting is condemned in Qur'an 49:12 as "eating the flesh of your dead brother."

75692.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75692.question_text: What is the name of the Prophet who cured the blind and lepers by Allah's permission?
75692.explanation: Isa healed the blind and lepers by Allah's permission (Qur'an 3:49).

75694.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75694.question_text: Which prayer is offered just after sunset?
75694.explanation: Maghrib is offered immediately after sunset and consists of three rak'ahs.

75695.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75695.question_text: The reward for fasting is with whom?
75695.explanation: According to Hadith Qudsi, "Fasting is Mine, and I will reward it" (Bukhari).

75696.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75696.question_text: What is the ruling on praying without ablution (wudu) in Islam?

75697.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75697.question_text: Who was the first martyr in Islam?
75697.explanation: Sumayyah was killed for accepting Islam and is recognised as the first martyr.

75698.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75698.explanation: Salat al-Wusta refers to the middle prayer, which is Asr (Qur'an 2:238).

75711.subject: Islamic Religious Knowledge (IRK)
75711.question_text: Which Prophet is known for his wisdom and ability to judge fairly?
75711.explanation: Prophet Dawud was known for fair judgment as referenced in Qur'an 38:20-22.
